name: EP11 Missed call -> text in 60 seconds (simulated send, 4 nodes)

nodes.name: Missed call in
nodes.notes: POST the missed-call event your phone system sends. Demo payload in README.

nodes.name: Compose the callback text
nodes.notes: Normalises any provider payload, decides if it was really missed, writes the SMS text. No send.

nodes.name: Log job + simulated SMS
nodes.notes: THIS IS THE SEND STEP, simulated. The composed text lands in a row; no telephony node exists on this canvas.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, call_id: $json.call_id, action: $json.action, job_status: $json.job_status, sms_to: $json.sms_to, sms_body: $json.sms_body, send_mode: $json.send_mode }) }}

nodes.name: Reply to the phone system
nodes.notes: Echoes the composed text back so curl shows what would have been sent.
